title: Welcome to r/StingrayResearch
author: Top-Geologist-3775
selftext:
This is a place to build and test trading strategies against market evidence.

A useful post makes four things explicit:

- the trading idea
- the evidence behind it
- assumptions and conditions that would prove it wrong
- what the historical or live-market result shows

Stingray links are welcome when the Reddit post contains enough context for a real discussion. Please disclose affiliations and avoid link-only promotion.

Stingray is a trading strategy builder: https://stingray.fi/

Stingray does not place trades. Nothing here is personalized financial advice.
